Here are some of the latest **NVIDIA** news highlights as of **June 2024**:

### **1. NVIDIA’s Stock Surge & Market Cap Milestones**
   - NVIDIA briefly became the **world’s most valuable company** (surpassing Microsoft and Apple) on **June 18, 2024**, with a market cap of **$3.34 trillion**, driven by AI demand.
   - Shares hit **all-time highs** (~$135+ per share) before a slight pullback.
   - Analysts predict further growth due to **AI data center demand**, with some setting price targets as high as **$150–$200 per share** (e.g., Rosenblatt Securities).

### **2. New AI & Hardware Announcements**
   - **Blackwell B200 GPUs** (next-gen AI chips) are **shipping ahead of schedule** (Q3 2024), with **2x performance** over Hopper H100.
   - **GB200 "Superchip"** (combining two B200 GPUs + Grace CPU) is being deployed by **Microsoft, Google, and Oracle** for AI training.
   - **Rubin Platform (2026)**: NVIDIA teased its **next-next-gen AI chips**, expected to succeed Blackwell.

### **3. AI Ecosystem & Partnerships**
   - **NVIDIA AI Foundry** (with Microsoft, Google, others) helps companies build **custom AI models** using NVIDIA’s infrastructure.
   - **Omniverse Cloud APIs** expanded for **industrial digital twins** (BMW, Siemens, Foxconn adopting).
   - **New AI Models**:
     - **Nemotron-4 340B** (open-weight LLM for synthetic data generation).
     - **NVIDIA ACE** (AI avatars for customer service) now supports **real-time multilingual interactions**.

### **4. Regulatory & Competition Updates**
   - **U.S. Export Restrictions**: NVIDIA’s **H100/A100 chips for China** face stricter controls, but the company is developing **compliant alternatives** (e.g., **H20**).
   - **AMD & Intel Competition**: AMD’s **MI300X** and Intel’s **Gaudí 3** are challenging NVIDIA’s dominance, but NVIDIA retains **~80% of the AI GPU market**.
   - **EU & U.S. Antitrust Scrutiny**: Regulators are examining NVIDIA’s **dominance in AI chips**, though no formal actions yet.

### **5. Financial Performance (Q1 2025 Earnings – May 2024)**
   - **Revenue**: **$26.0 billion** (+262% YoY), crushing estimates.
   - **Data Center Revenue**: **$22.6 billion** (+427% YoY), driven by **AI demand**.
   - **Gaming Revenue**: **$2.6 billion** (steady, despite declining GPU sales).
   - **Guidance**: Q2 revenue forecast at **$28.0 billion (±2%)**, above expectations.

### **6. Other Key Developments**
   - **Autonomous Vehicles**: NVIDIA’s **DRIVE Thor** platform adopted by **BYD, Zeekr, and others** for next-gen EVs.
   - **Quantum Computing**: Partnered with **Quantinuum** to accelerate quantum-classical computing.
   - **Robotics**: **Project GR00T** (general-purpose robotics model) demonstrated at **GTC 2024**.

### **7. Upcoming Events**
   - **SIGGRAPH 2024 (July 28–August 1)**: Expected **Omniverse & RTX updates**.
   - **Hot Chips 2024 (August)**: Possible **Blackwell & Rubin architecture details**.

---
### **Where to Follow for Real-Time Updates?**
- **NVIDIA Official**: [Blog](https://blogs.nvidia.com/) | [Investor Relations](https://investor.nvidia.com/)
- **Tech News**: [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/) | [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/nvidia/) | [Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/companies/NVDA.OQ/)
- **Stock Tracking**: [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/NVDA/) | [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/quote/NVDA:US)
